docs: the sector that this `Starbase` belongs to

fields.name: craftingFacility
docs: the [`CraftingFacility`] to use for crafting at this `Starbase`

fields.name: upgradeFacility
docs: the [`CraftingFacility`] to use for upgrade jobs at this `Starbase`

fields.name: state
docs: The state of the `Starbase`. Is a [`StarbaseState`].

fields.name: sectorRingAvailable
docs: The planet position (`sector::state::Ring`) available for this `Starbase`

fields.name: upgradeIngredientsChecksum
docs: used to check if expected upgrade ingredients have been supplied

fields.name: numUpgradeIngredients
docs: number of ingredients needed for starbase upgrade

fields.name: upkeepAmmoBalance
docs: The balance of ammo for upkeep

fields.name: upkeepAmmoLastUpdate
docs: The last time ammo for upkeep was updated (Local time)

fields.name: upkeepAmmoGlobalLastUpdate
docs: The last time ammo for upkeep was updated (Global time)

fields.name: upkeepFoodBalance
docs: The balance of food for upkeep

fields.name: upkeepFoodLastUpdate
docs: The last time food for upkeep was updated (Local time)

fields.name: upkeepFoodGlobalLastUpdate
docs: The last time food for upkeep was updated (Global time)

fields.name: upkeepToolkitBalance
docs: The balance of toolkits for upkeep

fields.name: upkeepToolkitLastUpdate
docs: The last time toolkits for upkeep was updated (Local time)

fields.name: upkeepToolkitGlobalLastUpdate
docs: The last time toolkits for upkeep was updated (Global time)

fields.name: builtDestroyedTimestamp
docs: The last time the starbase was built or destroyed

fields.name: pointsProgramPermissionsKeyIndex
docs: the index of the points program permissions in the player profile

fields.name: sagePermissionsKeyIndex
docs: the index of the key in sage permissions in the player profile

fields.name: resourceIndex
docs: the index of the resource represented by `token_mint` in the `resource_recipe` ingredients list

fields.name: epochIndex
docs: the index of the epoch in the `RedemptionConfig` account

fields.name: warpLaneFuelCostReduction
docs: Percentage by which the "warp lane" movement type reduces warp fuel cost

fields.name: respawnFee
docs: Respawn fee; You cannot enter into the respawning state without paying this fee
Since ATLAS has 8 decimal places, units are in the smallest value of ATLAS possible.

fields.name: upkeepMiningEmissionsPenalty
docs: Percentage by which to reduce the asteroid mining rate if a starbase ammo upkeep coffer is empty

fields.name: lpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Loyalty Points (LP)

fields.name: councilRankXpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Council Rank Experience Points (CRXP)

fields.name: pilotXpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Pilot License Experience Points (PXP)

fields.name: dataRunningXpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Data Running Experience Points (DRXP)

fields.name: miningXpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Mining Experience Points (MXP)

fields.name: craftingXpCategory
docs: Represents the points category & modifier to use for Crafting Experience Points (CXP)

types.name: SagePointsCategory
docs: Represents a points category & modifier as defined in the Points program

fields.name: recipeForUpgrade
docs: The crafting recipe required to upgrade a `Starbase` to this level

fields.name: recipeCategoryForLevel
docs: The crafting recipe category enabled for crafting at a `Starbase` of this level.

fields.name: hp
docs: The `Starbase` health points for this level.

fields.name: sp
docs: The `Starbase` shield points for this level.

fields.name: sectorRingAvailable
docs: The planet position `Ring` available for this level

fields.name: warpLaneMovementFee
docs: Fee charged for the "warp lane" movement type which is meant to be charged in ATLAS
Since ATLAS has 8 decimal places, units are in the smallest value of ATLAS possible.

fields.name: ammoReserve
docs: The maximum amount of ammo that can be committed upkeep by players
If 0 (zero) then ammo upkeep is disabled

fields.name: ammoDepletionRate
docs: The per second rate at which the ammo reserve is emptied

fields.name: foodReserve
docs: The maximum amount of food that can be committed upkeep by players
If 0 (zero) then food upkeep is disabled

fields.name: foodDepletionRate
docs: The per second rate at which the food reserve is emptied

fields.name: toolkitReserve
docs: The maximum amount of toolkits that can be committed upkeep by players
If 0 (zero) then toolkit upkeep is disabled

fields.name: toolkitDepletionRate
docs: The per second rate at which the toolkit reserve is emptied
